author: reek
body: Core domain types for the Market e-commerce suite. Every entity has a text ID (slug or generated). Prices are integers in the smallest currency unit (cents). Timestamps are integers (unix seconds).

author: reek
body: An option is a named axis of variation: Color, Size, Material, etc. Each option has a set of choices. Products pick which options apply and which choices are available.

author: reek
body: A product is a thing you sell. It has a base price, a description, and a set of option axes. Each combination of choices is a variant. Inventory is tracked per-variant (or per-product if no options).

author: reek
body: Custom fields let a merchant attach arbitrary typed metadata to any product. A field definition lives at the store level; products pick which fields apply and set values. This is the "sell anything" layer: wine has vintage and region, electronics have wattage and connector type, art has medium and dimensions.

author: reek
body: Auctions let sellers list items for timed competitive bidding. Supports reserve prices, buy-it-now, bid increments, proxy bidding (automatic outbid up to max), snipe protection (extends deadline on late bids), and sealed-bid (highest-wins, second-price Vickrey).

author: reek
body: A merchant is a seller who lists products on the marketplace. The platform handles storefront, payment, and customer service. The merchant handles inventory and fulfillment (or uses drop-ship suppliers). Revenue is split per the commission agreement.

author: reek
body: A drop-ship supplier fulfills orders on behalf of merchants. The merchant never touches the product. The supplier ships directly to the customer. Profit = merchant markup over supplier cost.

author: reek
body: Content creators are merchants who sell digital goods, courses, media, or experiences. They get a creator profile with portfolio, follower count, content feed, and tips/donations support.
